module.Title: Create a Reusable Method
module.Teaching: A method gives a named block of code one job. Calling the method runs that job.
module.PredictionExplanation: void means the method performs work without returning a result.
module.DebugPrompt: A method declaration needs parentheses after its name.
module.RecallPrompt: Write ShowMessage from memory. Use these exact identifiers: Console, WriteLine. Use the exact value "Ready!".
module.TransferPrompt: Create ShowInventory that prints "Inventory opened". Use these exact identifiers: Console, WriteLine.
module.PreviewMessage: The project now contains a reusable method.
